description: Repeatable prepared-road and native backed-up-traffic workloads, physical Mac and Pixel 7a production runs, 2026-11-11. Raw reports/profiles remain in ignored data/scratch/driving-239/.
methodology: Fresh page/Worker/world/renderer per cell; ordinary shared authority, prediction and GPU rendering. Exactly 180 fixed idle warm-up ticks, initial asset/terrain readiness and 60 paused idle cadence samples. Main windows are wall-time, qualified by actual authority progress, named poses, vehicle counts and queue state. Fixed geometry/input, not bit-exact live scheduling. Prepared flat roads exclude regional generation, city art and physical storage I/O; ordinary memory-record bookkeeping remains. Per-page caches reset; browser/driver caches and process JIT are not reset. Allocation samples include collected objects and bookkeeping; ordinary cadence runs are separate.

validation.nativeReplay: Two fresh 900-tick traces per fixture after 180 idle ticks; all per-second named poses identical; 32 autonomous jam cars and exact admitted populations preserved.
validation.phoneComparison: Second independent production run uses CLI --compare against the first; matched workload and initial-pose checks pass.
